name: scheduler-list
description: List scheduled jobs (most recent first, trimmed summary view). Optionally filter by status (pending, running, completed, failed, suspended, cancelled, paused) or agent_id, and cap results with limit (default 50, max 200). status takes a single value. To find an existing routine before changing it or creating one like it, list without a status filter and look for an active job (pending, running, suspended or paused) with the same agent and task; taskPreview shows the start of each job's task. Include running jobs: a routine that happens to be mid-run is still the same routine. If that unfiltered listing comes back truncated, older active jobs may be missing from it: list again with agent_id and with status set to each active status in turn. For full detail on a single job, use scheduler-report.

outputs.jobs: array (summary per job: id, agentId, status, cronExpr, runAt, nextRunAt, taskTitle, taskPreview — the first 160 characters of the job's task — and similar fields)
